data_steps.description: commands that create the data every cell reads, in order, run once before any cell

argv.description: python, the script path relative to the repository root, then its arguments

evidence.description: path:line where the repository gives or implies this command

step.description: the step name (in each cell that uses this parser) whose log holds the number

line_regex.description: Python regex, searched in each log line

run_start_regex.description: regex of the line that starts each run (seed) block; null if the number is printed once for the whole log

per_epoch.description: true if a matching line is printed once per epoch in each run block

count.description: matching lines per block when per_epoch is false

evidence.description: path:line of the print statement that writes the line

claim_ids.description: exactly one id for linked and derived; one or more for unlinked

evidence.description: path:line of the repository command this follows

reason.description: for unlinked and derived cells: why; otherwise empty
